description: Implement the AWS CDK infrastructure stack in TypeScript. Defines Lambda functions, HTTP API Gateways, and DynamoDB tables for both services with least-privilege IAM.
steps: Create infra/package.json with devDependencies: aws-cdk-lib, constructs, typescript, ts-node, @types/node. Add scripts: build (tsc), cdk (cdk).
Create infra/tsconfig.json with standard CDK TypeScript config (target ES2020, module commonjs, strict true, outDir dist).
Create infra/cdk.json pointing to bin/app.ts as the app entry.
Create infra/bin/app.ts - CDK App entry point that instantiates AutoEarsDemoStack.
Create infra/lib/autoearsdemo-stack.ts with a single CDK Stack class containing:
- DynamoDB Table for Users: partition key 'id' (STRING), billingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST, removalPolicy DESTROY for dev
- DynamoDB Table for Tasks: partition key 'id' (STRING), billingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST, removalPolicy DESTROY for dev. Add GSI on 'userId' for filtering.
- Lambda Function for Users: runtime NODEJS_18_X, handler 'handler.handler', code from '../services/users', env var USERS_TABLE pointing to users table name
- Lambda Function for Tasks: runtime NODEJS_18_X, handler 'handler.handler', code from '../services/tasks', env var TASKS_TABLE pointing to tasks table name
- HttpApi for Users: add routes integrating all 5 CRUD paths to usersLambda via HttpLambdaIntegration
- HttpApi for Tasks: add routes integrating all 5 CRUD paths to tasksLambda via HttpLambdaIntegration
- CfnOutput for both API Gateway URLs

Use imports from 'aws-cdk-lib', 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-lambda', 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-dynamodb', '@aws-cdk/aws-apigatewayv2-alpha' (or aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2 if using stable), 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2-integrations'.
acceptance_criteria: infra/package.json exists with aws-cdk-lib and constructs as dependencies
infra/cdk.json exists and points to the correct app entry
infra/lib/autoearsdemo-stack.ts defines both DynamoDB tables, both Lambda functions, both API Gateways, and grants least-privilege IAM
CDK stack uses HttpApi (HTTP API v2) not RestApi
GSI on Tasks table for userId-based queries
verification: Read infra/lib/autoearsdemo-stack.ts and confirm all constructs are defined
Read infra/package.json and confirm aws-cdk-lib is listed
Read infra/cdk.json and confirm app entry is correct
